skills.description_zh:
AI配音生成助手 — 多音色+情感控制+多语言，为视频/播客/广告生成专业级配音方案
熟练掌握各类AI配音生成工具的操作与应用，能够根据不同场景需求完成语音合成创作：精通音色筛选与参数调试，可针对短视频解说、有声读物、广告宣传片、教育课件等不同内容调性，匹配适配的风格音色；掌握声音克隆技术操作流程，可通过1分钟以内的音频样本复刻专属声线，实现角色语音的一致性；擅长文本预处理与韵律调整，能通过分段生成、标点优化、插入停顿换气标记等方式提升语音自然度，支持多语种、多方言语音转换，可完成多角色批量配音与字幕同步导出，能在3分钟内完成千字文本的配音生成与导出，满足内容创作者快速量产需求。

产品功能技能描述（推广/介绍版）
依托深度学习语音合成算法，具备多元化专业配音生成能力：

‌海量音色库适配‌：覆盖500+高拟真AI音色，包含男女声、特色网红音、方言、多国外语，细分影视解说、小说推文、综艺二创、商业广告等场景专属音色，精准匹配内容调性
‌个性化定制能力‌：支持专属音色克隆，仅需少量音频样本即可复刻目标声线，存储后可随时调用；支持语速、音量、语调自由调节，可插入停顿、换气标记调整韵律，满足个性化语音需求
‌高效批量处理‌：支持长文本分段合成、多角色同步配音，短文本即时生成，长文本最快3分钟输出，支持多格式高清音频导出，可搭配字幕导出功能，适配各类视频剪辑流程
‌创意拓展功能‌：支持AI语音唱歌、背景音乐添加、多音字智能纠错、视频文案提取等增值功能，一站式满足声音创作全需求。
skills.name: AI配音生成器

skills.description: Richard Feynman's "What Do You Care What Other People Think?" — an executable toolkit that captures Feynman's approach to curiosity, scientific thinking, integrity under pressure, and living a life unconstrained by others' opinions.  Covers 5 use cases: ① Cultivating Curiosity — develop a relentless, playful curiosity about how the world works ("How do I become more curious" "I want to think like a scientist" "How to ask better questions") ② Thinking for Yourself — resist groupthink, trust your own reasoning, don't be swayed by authority or popularity ("How do I think independently" "Everyone disagrees with me" "How to trust my own judgment") ③ Integrity Under Pressure — stand by the truth even when it's unpopular, as Feynman did in the Challenger investigation ("How to speak truth to power" "I'm pressured to go along" "How to maintain integrity at work") ④ Learning Anything — the Feynman Technique: learn deeply by teaching simply ("How to learn anything fast" "I don't understand this topic" "How to explain complex ideas simply") ⑤ Living Authentically — embrace your quirks, don't perform for others, find joy in your own path ("I feel like I'm pretending to be someone else" "How to be myself" "I care too much what others think")  Trigger when users say: "How to think like Feynman" "Feynman technique" "What do you care what other people think" "Scientific thinking" "Critical thinking" "How to learn" "Speak truth to power" "Challenger disaster" "Be myself" "Think independently" "How to be curious" "Groupthink" "Question authority" "How to explain things simply" or mention: Richard Feynman / curiosity / scientific method / Challenger / O-ring / integrity / independent thinking / learning technique / Feynman Technique / physics / authentic living / truth.  Also triggers when the user says they just installed this skill or doesn't know how to start — the AI MUST proactively present the Quick Start guide below.
